quarterly_data.quarter: Xanadu press release: Xanadu Charts Path to Over 1,000 Logical Qubits by 2031 (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Technology roadmap (August 31, 2026): Xanadu targets reducing its key loss technical indicator from 24.1x by 2026 to 1.0x by 2030; Qubit Factory build 2026-2027; a fault tolerance milestone in 2028-2029; up to 200 logical qubits by 2029, up to 500 by 2030 and 1,000+ by 2031; logical error rates improving from roughly 10^-3 to 10^-8 in 2028 to 10^-16 by 2030; and a quantum data center in 2029-2030, with meaningful end-customer commercialization targeted by 2029-2030. CEO Christian Weedbrook: the cut in loss ratio gives confidence in reaching fault tolerance in 2028-2029. PennyLane: used by 30.8% of developers surveyed, more than 1,890 public repositories depend on it, approximately 1.1 million package installs a month, 51 devices reachable and more than 150 university partners in more than 35 countries. Cash and cash equivalents were US$312.8 million at June 30, 2026, plus approximately US$140.2 million (CAD $195 million) of confirmed Government of Canada funding under Project OPTIMISM.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 200 logical qubits by 2029, 500 by 2030, 1,000+ by 2031; loss indicator 24.1x (2026) to 1.0x (2030)
